source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Have you not seen, O Messenger, how your Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant — Abraha the Abyssinian and his army, who wanted to destroy the blessed Kaaba?
tafsir.muyassar-2: Did He not turn what they plotted of evil into failure and ruin?
tafsir.muyassar-3: And He sent upon them birds in successive flocks, striking them with stones of hardened clay.
tafsir.muyassar-4: And He sent upon them birds in successive flocks, striking them with stones of hardened clay.
tafsir.muyassar-5: So He made them like dry crop leaves that cattle had eaten and then cast away.
